# Moho Studio MCP

> Zero-dependency Node.js stdio MCP server and Moho Pro 14.4 Lua 5.4 plugin for live 2D animation authoring, rigging, Smart Warp, Curvers, Liquid Shapes, Saved Styles, Layer Comps, glTF 2.0 export, and headless CLI rendering on Windows.

Moho Studio MCP exposes 78 MCP tools (75 live Lua RPCs plus 3 Windows host tools) and 2 MCP resources (`moho-studio://guide` and `moho-studio://playbook`) over JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio (`2024-11-05`). It requires Windows 10/11 x64, Moho Pro 14.4, and Node.js 20+.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Requirements, installation, client configuration (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Antigravity), tool table, and security notes.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Process topology, atomic file IPC, crash-safe dispatch (`DrawMe` vs `HandleMessage`), and undo coalescing.
- [docs/MOHO_14_4_LUA_API_VERIFIED.md](docs/MOHO_14_4_LUA_API_VERIFIED.md): Verified Moho Pro 14.4 Lua 5.4 signatures, constants, CLI renderer flags, and runtime gotchas.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Contributor and coding-agent rules, Moho Lua safety invariants, and verification commands.

## Entry Points

- [src/server.mjs](src/server.mjs): Stdio MCP server entrypoint (`node src/server.mjs`).
- [server.json](server.json): MCP Registry manifest (`io.github.SavasTanriverdi/moho-studio-mcp`).
- [src/tools.mjs](src/tools.mjs): JSON Schema definitions for all 78 MCP tools.
- [src/playbook.mjs](src/playbook.mjs): Text of the `moho-studio://playbook` MCP resource (15 Moho Pro 14.4 rules).
- [src/ipc.mjs](src/ipc.mjs): Atomic temp-and-rename IPC client, Win32 `PrintWindow`/`PostMessage` helpers, and headless `Moho.exe -r` CLI render runner.
- [moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Server.lua](moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Server.lua): Moho Pro 14.4 Menu script registering all 75 live Lua RPC handlers.
- [moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Poller.lua](moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Poller.lua): Neutral Poller tool with the `"MCP Sync"` button for `HandleMessage(MSG_POLL)` dispatch.
- [scripts/install.py](scripts/install.py): Dry-run-first installer for Moho plugin files and Codex/Antigravity client configs.
- [scripts/check_hygiene.py](scripts/check_hygiene.py): Offline checker for UTF-8/ASCII hygiene, `node --check`, Lua syntax balance, and 1:1 Node-to-Lua RPC parity.

## Quick Setup

1. Install plugin: `python scripts/install.py --scope moho-plugin --apply` (Administrator PowerShell for Program Files, or pass `--moho-scripts-dir` for a Moho Custom Content Folder).
2. In Moho Pro 14.4: reload scripts (`Ctrl+Shift+Alt+L`) and click `Scripts > MohoStudioMCP > Start/Stop MohoStudioMCP Server`.
3. Configure your MCP client to run `node /path/to/moho-studio-mcp/src/server.mjs`.
4. Call `moho_status` and read `moho-studio://playbook` before editing a live document.

## Verification

- `python scripts/check_hygiene.py`
- `npm test`
